[BW-UK-SHIFT] Leeds plant shift, overtime and premium rules
Leeds operators are paid time and a half for hours worked after 39 hours in a week and double time on bank holidays. Night shift premium is 15 percent of the base rate. Shift swaps need the supervisor's approval 24 hours ahead.

[BW-US-SHIFT] Ohio plants shift, overtime and premium rules
Hourly plant staff in Ohio are paid one and a half times the base rate for hours worked after 40 hours in a week. Night shift premium is 1.25 dollars an hour. Shift swaps need the supervisor's approval in the timekeeping app 24 hours ahead.

[BW-UK-ATT-LIST] Leeds attendance cases open, May 2027
Open attendance cases at Leeds: Kerry Ashworth (stage 1, line 3), Liam Doyle (stage 2, line 1, review June 14).

[BW-GRP-SAFE] Stop-work rule for all plants
Anyone who sees a missing guard, a bypassed interlock or an unsafe act may stop the line. Press the nearest stop button, tell the shift supervisor, and log it in the safety app before the end of the shift. No one is disciplined for a stop made in good faith.
